name: diet-toke
description: Maximum-savings AI token compressor via local multi-provider proxy, 1-hop import slicing, and global MCP server.

commands.title: Diet Toke: Copy Shell Export Commands
Diet Toke: Sync Global Agent MCP Configs
Diet Toke: Show Token Savings Stats
Diet Toke: Reset Lifetime Token Stats
Diet Toke: Open Token Analytics Dashboard

dietToke.port.description: Local loopback port for the Diet Toke proxy and MCP server.

dietToke.enabled.description: Enable 5-layer token compression on proxied LLM requests.

dietToke.pruneTools.description: Prune unused MCP/tool schemas based on the active prompt.

dietToke.injectPromptCache.description: Inject cache_control breakpoints for Anthropic/OpenAI prefix caching.

dietToke.autoSyncGlobalMcp.description: Automatically register Diet Toke MCP server in ~/.claude.json, ~/.cursor/mcp.json, and ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json.

dietToke.autoSyncAgentRules.description: Automatically inject Diet Toke MCP usage rules into global Claude, Copilot, Cline, Roo Code, and Cursor instruction files.

dietToke.autoConfigureShellRc.description: Automatically add a health-checked Diet Toke proxy block to ~/.zshrc and ~/.bashrc for external terminals.

scripts.package: npm run compile && npx vsce package --allow-missing-repository
